title: DeviceStatus
description: An Agent-to-Server observation for one Server-owned logical job. Sequence allocation is scoped per jobId and owned by the Agent. The first durably enqueued distinct observation uses sequence 0; each newly durably enqueued distinct observation increments it by exactly 1. A retry or replay reuses the exact request body, sequence, and Idempotency-Key. HTTP delivery need not arrive contiguously or in allocation order.

sequence.description: Agent-allocated sequence scoped to the jobId in Idempotency-Key status:<jobId>:<sequence>. The suffix MUST equal this value. Allocation starts at 0 and increments by exactly 1 only for a newly durably enqueued distinct observation; replay reuses the existing value.
